comments.text:
Hope you enjoy the video! Some notes:
- In the 7800 XT Launch video (2 videos ago) some individual game graphs had some data input errors in them. Those are corrected here. So the numbers you see here are correct for the 7700 XT Gaming OC, 7800 XT Reference and 7800 XT Gaming OC. (Earlier summaries and the comparisons with other cards were not affected)
- Undervolting 7800 XT video will go live next . Should be interesting as we managed to get power consumption down by a lot. So if you're after an AMD card and are OK with tweaking your power settings, stay tuned!
- REMINDER: I will NEVER reply to your comment asking you to text a number or send a telegram message. Please do not fall for those scams!

comments.text: I got the twin fan pulse and it's the best card i've tried. Ridiculously low hotspot temperatures after undervolting, so much so that the fans are sometimes having trouble and can't decide if they want to spin or not, which is why i usually disable Zero RPM and have them run at minimum speed when playing games, and that's in a case with 4 fans, 1 exhaust and 3 front intake. Amazing performance paired with a Ryzen 7 5700x, I comfortably get 120-144 fps on ultra 1440p in most games I play, and with FSR 2 and 3, and AMFMF 2 being a thing nowadays, you're guaranteed to have 120+ fps in ANY game. It's an absolute unit for the 430€ i spent on it.
